metrics.investment_case_interpretation: The company qualifies for the profit-cheap list because market cap divided by discounted sustainable distributable cash profit is about 4.1 years, below the 15-year threshold. The owner earnback period after deducting negative detachable net cash is about 10.5 years; the gap versus market-profit payback is caused by heavy net interest-bearing debt and limited detachable cash under the PRC/VIE education structure.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: The annual report does not split parent/offshore/PRC/VIE cash. PRC operating schools and sponsors contributed 100% of revenue, 132% of net profit and 96% of assets, and higher education is a restricted foreign-investment category, so the education-company VIE cash default range is used conservatively.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially cash-like, but not freely detachable without affecting school obligations and PRC/VIE cash movement constraints.

cash_breakdown.item: Financial assets at FVTPL: Mainland bank wealth products and FX options
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: The products are unlisted Mainland bank wealth products and FX options classified at FVTPL; product terms and principal protection are not disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash-like investment asset, but non-guaranteed/structured nature and PRC location require a low haircut factor.

cash_breakdown.item: Pledged deposits for bank and other loans
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Not freely detachable; treated only as an offset against secured borrowings to avoid double-counting both the deposit and the related debt.
cash_breakdown.reason: The deposit secures bank and other borrowings under note 25.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Project deposit is restricted and not available for extraction.

cash_breakdown.item: Gross interest-bearing bank and other borrowings
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Bank and other borrowings are deducted at 100%; the pledged deposit above is then used as a debt offset, giving net financing debt deduction of RMB2,511,782,000.
cash_breakdown.reason: Current and non-current secured bank/other borrowings.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: The company runs schools with prepaid tuition/boarding obligations and large current liabilities. About RMB300 million is retained as roughly 1.7 months of FY2023 cash operating cost/revenue support, not as extractable surplus.
cash_breakdown.reason: Required to keep schools operating and absorb cash flow timing.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: A conservative reserve is held because most cash is RMB/PRC-related and the structure involves dividend/withholding-tax and FX movement friction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Friction reserve before extracting or upstreaming cash.

profit_quality.assessment: Profit cash conversion is strong at the operating cash flow level because tuition and boarding fees are received in advance, but the business is not a pure cash box: it keeps investing in school buildings, facilities, equipment and software, and cash sits mainly inside a PRC/VIE education structure. The main denominator is therefore reduced from a pre-haircut RMB538 million distributable cash profit to RMB403.5 million.
adjustments: Used recent parent net profit history: RMB567.824 million in 2021, RMB620.003 million in 2022 and RMB703.289 million in 2023; the 2022 median profit is the base.
Added back an estimated depreciation/amortisation cash conversion benefit but deducted RMB300 million estimated maintenance capex; FY2023 disclosed total capital expenditure was RMB745.7 million.
Excluded about RMB22 million of bank/wealth-product income related to funds assets to avoid double-counting returns on capital treated in the cash pool.
Applied a 0.75 profit haircut because cash conversion is good, while VIE/PRC education restrictions, prepaid student obligations and recurring campus capex limit free distributability.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow was RMB728.779 million in 2021, RMB1,534.190 million in 2022 and RMB1,422.847 million in 2023; FY2023 operating cash flow was far above reported profit, but after disclosed capital expenditure of RMB745.7 million the surplus is materially lower.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Stable cash collection supports the denominator, but PRC/VIE cash movement, student prepayment obligations, debt service and continuing campus investment justify a material haircut.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Strong operating cash conversion, structurally supported by advance tuition and boarding fee collection.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Exact maintenance capex is not disclosed. RMB300 million is used as a conservative maintenance-like estimate versus FY2023 total capex of RMB745.7 million and D&A around RMB270 million.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Receivables are small and contract liabilities increased, so no extra normal working-capital reinvestment is deducted beyond the operating cash reserve and profit haircut.

limitations: The requested period is 2023-12-31, but the issuer's annual report is for the year ended 2023-08-31.
Market cap is from the rough screen historical signal, not a current market quote.
The annual report does not split cash by listed parent, offshore entities, PRC subsidiaries or VIE schools.
Maintenance capex is estimated because the annual report only discloses total capital expenditure.
Education/VIE cash, student prepayments and debt service make detachable cash materially less certain than reported cash.
